Today I had some gastrointestinal issues and was on the verge of passing out when I came to this clinic. They admitted me immediately and I must say the service was amazing. They were so kind to me and very professional. They go above and beyond for their patients. If in an unfortunate case you need a doctor I can only recommend this clinic.

Thank you to the team again for helping me!
